# Roman road test fixture

`roman-road-aiton.geojson` is Itiner-e segment 23379, **Potaissa–Napoca**,
by Jens Christoffersen (bibliography: Fodorean 2013, BAtlas 21). Its geometry
is unchanged; the `pleiadesPlaces` field was omitted. The segment is marked
*Conjectured* in the source and includes the Aiton area.

Source: the public [2025 Itiner-e NDJSON snapshot](https://github.com/Nk173/itinereX/blob/main/data_cleaning/raw/route-segments-all-1764347876852.ndjson)
(Git blob `7e8590310383aeeee086f46e6a0d81861ce60104`); this segment also appears
in the current DetectLab export. See de Soto et al.,
[Itiner-e: A high-resolution dataset of roads of the Roman Empire](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-06140-z).
Itiner-e data is licensed [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
